title: docs(AGENTS.md): a table of contents; the mechanism prose of §Build & Test and §Multi-agent working discipline moves to docs/agents/ topic pages, every rule staying as one sentence plus a pointer

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`AGENTS.md` 加了目录(`## Contents`,17 个二级标题各一行,GitHub 锚点);§Build & Test 与 §Multi-agent working discipline 里的 34 段机制说明**原文逐字节**迁到 `docs/agents/build-and-test.md`、`docs/agents/multi-agent-discipline.md`(索引 `docs/agents/README.md`),每条规则仍留在 `AGENTS.md`——一句话加一个指针(31 个)。`AGENTS.md` 1112 → 1050 行、82,609 → 76,432 字节;两节 140 → 125、317 → 247 行;行数棘轮上限随之 1112 → 1050。其余 15 节与 Prime Directives 逐字节未动。
- **为什么改**:裁决 6417533492 字母 A(维护者「其他同意」,2026-10-26T13:43Z):规则留一处、解释迁出;首次进门的贡献者和每个会话都加载它的席位,读到的是更短、可导航的规则文件,解释一链之遥。
- **风险与回滚**:风险是某段被我判为「解释」迁走,而你认为它是规则——下表逐段列出来源行与落点,任一段可单独拉回(改 `AGENTS.md` 并从 `docs/agents/` 删去同段)。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的单个 commit。
- **先看**:① 下表「Moved paragraphs」,按风险排:L534–546 Re-arm awareness 整段迁出只留一句新裁句;L596–632 §11 合并驱动的五段;L558–577 §9 过期产物表与 `check:dev-prereqs` 一句。② `AGENTS.md` 里 §7、§9、§11 的新留句(hunk 位于新文件 L531–621 一带)。③ `docs/agents/multi-agent-discipline.md` 页首那段「`AGENTS.md` 是权威」说明。
- **两分钟验证**:`git diff --color-moved=zebra origin/main...HEAD -- AGENTS.md docs/agents/` —— 预期:迁出段在两侧都以 moved 色成对出现(逐字节相同),`AGENTS.md` 侧只剩新增的指针行与新裁句;`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 预期印出 `AGENTS.md is 1050 lines (ceiling 1050; headroom 0)`。
- **需要你做的**:Tier H ——对本 PR 给一次 APPROVED review;落地由席位执行。

## What changes

- `AGENTS.md`: a `## Contents` block (23 lines: one anchor link per `##` heading in file order, GitHub slug form; the two reworked sections also link their topic page) after the preamble and before `## Communication`. §Build & Test 140 → 125 lines and §Multi-agent working discipline 317 → 247 lines: 34 explanation fragments (150 BASE line-spans) moved out verbatim, every rule sentence kept (every ⛔ line stays — 66 before, 66 after), 31 pointers of the form `([why](docs/agents/PAGE.md#anchor))` added. The seven headings `CONTRIBUTING.md` links (10 links) are unchanged and resolve. Nothing else in the file moved: Prime Directives and every section from Monorepo Layout to the end are byte-equal to `origin/main`.
- `docs/agents/build-and-test.md` (74 lines) and `docs/agents/multi-agent-discipline.md` (257 lines): the moved fragments, byte-identical to the BASE text, one `##` per source paragraph with a back-link to the companion `AGENTS.md` section; the page preamble says `AGENTS.md` is the authority and how to pull a paragraph back. `docs/agents/README.md` (13 lines): the index — plain repository markdown next to `docs/adr/` and `docs/qa/`, not `content/docs/**`.
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: the `AGENTS.md` ceiling row 1112 → 1050 (a lowering, the ratchet's ordinary direction; landed count, headroom 0; the widest-table-row pin 768 is unchanged — the widest row is the translations row in Documentation Guardrails, untouched).

Everything else that stays is the original wording.

### Sizing, measured against the route's expectation

The dispatch route expected roughly a third off the file; measured, the net is −62 lines (−5.6 %) and −6,177 bytes (−7.5 %). The two sections are denser in rule sentences than the card's 28 % "narrative" estimate assumed: of their 457 lines, 150 line-spans met the move test of hypothesis 1 (a reader who obeys the sentence that stays is no less safe without the paragraph) — the ownership protocol, the force-push criteria, the nine required contexts, the governed-PR classes, the `Clocked windows` ruling chain and the footer forms are rules and stay. The Contents block costs 23 of the lines back. A larger cut would have meant compressing rule paragraphs into summaries, which 「一处维护」 and the ruling ("no rule is restated, only its explanation moves") both refuse.
